name: shanti-roles
description: Shanti Roles: Claude Code plugins that give each session a Role picked from a dropdown above the chat box, plus an always-on usage band.

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Always-visible line above the chat box: context window fill and plan usage limits (session + weekly), with mini bars.

plugins.name: session-role
plugins.description: Give each session a Role picked from a dropdown above the chat box: local (.claude/roles) or global (~/.claude/roles) job descriptions with an edit fence, tool limits and a live subagent indicator.
